full.scheme_lift: The reduced geometric support of the full layer-through-eight obstruction scheme is empty over an algebraic closure. A nonzero finite-type K0-algebra stays nonzero after faithfully flat base change and then has a maximal ideal, so the full layer-through-eight obstruction scheme retaining the square equation is empty as well; the layer-four square hypersurface alone is not claimed empty.
